about: Suggest an idea or improvement

---

## What problem does this solve?

A clear description of the problem or use case. ("I'm frustrated
when...", "It's currently not possible to...")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If you have a specific UI/behavior in mind,
describe it (mockups/sketches welcome but not required).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Anything else

Check [docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md) first — your idea might
already be planned. Mention here if it's related to something there, or
if you'd be interested in implementing it yourself (worth opening this
issue first to discuss approach, per
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).
